description.value: Carnivore Meats & More is a specialty butcher shop sourcing grass-fed, antibiotic- and hormone-free meats exclusively from farms within 100 miles of the shop. Whole animals are broken down and hand-cut in-house, making it a standout stop for cyclists looking to pick up quality local protein on the Saanich Peninsula. The passionate owner is known for educating customers about sustainable, ethical farming practices.
